final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS ballot_count FROM hall_of_fame AS h JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), above_average AS (SELECT ballot_count FROM state_counts WHERE ballot_count > (SELECT AVG(ballot_count) FROM state_counts)) SELECT AVG(ballot_count) AS average_count, AVG(ballot_count - (SELECT AVG(ballot_count) FROM state_counts)) AS average_excess_over_overall FROM above_average
